summary: Describes the EPP mapping for provisioning and managing host names, such as name servers, in a shared central repository. It defines how EPP commands and responses work for host objects, in XML. It was replaced by RFC 4932.

eli5.summary: Computers that answer for domain names need their own entries. This part of the registry language says how to add, change and look up those entries.

questions: how are name servers registered in epp
